description: Teopoki Korean helps users search and organize their personal Korean vocabulary, inspect everyday polite verb conjugations, see due and weak words, and understand learning progress. New vocabulary is always shown as an exact preview and saved only after explicit confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Show my saved travel verbs with their present polite, past polite, and future forms.
Create today’s review using my due and weak words, then summarize my current progress.
Suggest 10 useful Korean words for talking to my baby’s grandparents. Preview everything and wait for my approval before saving.
